title: EDA Notebook Compiler
description: Compiles Exploratory Data Analysis Jupyter notebooks. Enforces mandatory sections (missing values, distributions, correlations, key findings), no raw data mutation, reproducibility via random seeds, and documented insights.

error_codes.EN002: Notebook missing required sections: missing values, distributions, correlations, key findings
error_codes.EN003: EDA notebook writes to raw data directory — raw data is immutable
error_codes.EN004: No random seed set — EDA results are not reproducible
error_codes.EN005: No missing value analysis (isnull, isna, info, describe)
error_codes.EN006: No distribution analysis (hist, boxplot, describe, value_counts)
error_codes.EN007: No correlation analysis (corr, heatmap, pairplot, scatter)
error_codes.EN008: No key findings documented in markdown cell
